title: 1x8 Splitter Tree Using Cascaded 1x2 MMIs
summary: Create a 1x8 optical power splitter tree by cascading 1x2 MMI splitters in a binary tree topology, using seven 1x2 MMIs total.

blocks.notes: Binary tree: Stage 1 uses 1 MMI to split 1 input into 2; Stage 2 uses 2 MMIs to split into 4; Stage 3 uses 4 MMIs to split into 8. Target ~50/50 split per MMI at design wavelength. Include standard single-mode input/output tapers as part of the MMI cell if available in the PDK.

wiring_notes: Connect the single input waveguide to the input of the Stage-1 1x2 MMI.
Route the two outputs of Stage-1 MMI to the inputs of the two Stage-2 MMIs (one output per MMI).
Route the four outputs of Stage-2 MMIs to the inputs of the four Stage-3 MMIs (one output per MMI).
Expose the eight outputs of Stage-3 MMIs as the final 1x8 splitter outputs (8 separate output ports).

Use symmetric routing and matched path lengths within each stage (and ideally across all 8 output paths) to balance phase and minimize skew; add serpentine sections only if needed for length matching.
Maintain minimum bend radius and waveguide spacing per process rules; avoid crossings if possible or use crossing cells if required by floorplan.
Keep output port pitch and orientation consistent with downstream connectivity / fiber array requirements (if unspecified, choose a standard pitch from the PDK).

objective.target_behavior: 1 optical input evenly split into 8 outputs using a 3-stage binary tree of 1x2 MMI splitters (nominally equal power to each output).
